home-meta-description: Discover the portfolio of Macéo Jalbert, a developer and computer science student passionate about building innovative web projects, UX and modern technologies.
hero-component-description:
I introduce myself, my name is Macéo JALBERT and I am a young computer science student.I am passionate about computers and new technologies.
Since I was little, I like to understand how everything around me works. It is with this curiosity that I fell on computer science.
It is an incredible universe full of resources, it allows you to create what you want as long as you know where to look and that you are persistent.
projects-component-featured-title: Projects I am most proud of
homelab-component-description: I run a self-hosted infrastructure on bare-metal servers at home. It hosts personal projects, development environments, and production services — all managed with Kubernetes (K3s), monitored 24/7.
